title: Chapter 110 The Attributes Of The Golden Boss
content:
Chapter 110 The Attributes Of The Golden Boss

There is really no nonsense.

As soon as he finished speaking, Brunei stuck out his tongue again and came straight to Wang Shuo.

This tongue, which is thicker than a bucket, is no joke. It shoots out in the air, creating a gust of wind in the surrounding air.

"Lord Lord."

Seeing this sharp blow, Wang Shuo's mind went blank. He seemed to have been restrained and unable to move at all.

With this attack, Brunei directly launched the skill "Giant Tongue Attack".

As for why Wang Shuo couldn't move, it was because of his other skill "Deterrence".

All targets he attacks will be deterred.

This is also the reason why Bai Ming was easily swallowed up by Brunei even though he was already the silver boss.

Brunei's attack came without any warning, and basically no one reacted.

Dongfang Ling was far away from Wang Shuo. When she saw this blow, she suddenly felt an inexplicable pain in her heart.

He opened his mouth, but no sound came out.

However, among Wang Shuo's subjects, there was still Ayub, who was extremely skilled in combat and was closest to Wang Shuo, and he reacted.

At this critical moment, he jumped into the air, holding the Green Dragon Sword tightly with both hands.

A shocking blow was made.

This move is obviously to encircle Wei and save Zhao.

If Brunei's tongue does not change direction, it risks being severed.

Just when Wang Shuo thought he was saved.

Brunei's tongue didn't change direction and still hit him.

Everyone, especially Ayub, couldn't figure out why Brunei didn't choose to give up this attack.

In the blink of an eye, everyone got the answer.

Because his tongue is as hard as a golden weapon.

He was not afraid of Ayub's chops at all.

However, Ayub's attack still slightly changed the direction of his tongue.

Wang Shuo was only hit in the abdomen. Since he was also wearing high-grade crocodile leather armor, his body was not penetrated.

The huge impact directly knocked him dozens of meters away. Of his nearly 3,000 health points, only a layer of blood skin remained, less than 200 points.

Moreover, his body was severely damaged and he almost lost the ability to fight again.

"Lord Lord!"

"Lord Lord!"

…

Gong Zheng's eyes were red and his teeth were bared!

Duan Wenxi's brows drooped and he was about to cry!

Gu Liji, Li Jianguo and others were all shocked and could not hide their grief!

Just when everyone thought Wang Shuo was dead.

He raised his right hand with difficulty.

I really want to say: "I'm not dead yet, I can still be saved!"

But he didn't make any sound. Just this simple movement seemed to have exhausted all his strength.

"The Lord is still alive!"

Dongfang Ling also breathed a sigh of relief!

The moment Gong Zheng flew out of Wang Shuo, he ran straight over.

Lifting Wang Shuo's head and holding him in his arms, Gong Zheng quickly took out the "big red medicine".

They stuffed them into Wang Shuo's mouth one by one.

Dongfang Ling saw that Wang Shuo was seriously injured and ran over quickly. As he ran, he cursed angrily: "Damn stinky toad!"

Brunei couldn't believe his ears.

Someone actually dared to call him a "stinky toad".

This is the sentence he hates the most. The last time he heard this sentence was when he had just become a bronze boss.

He got angry and the consequences were serious.

He immediately turned around and found the person who scolded him.

After taking the red medicine, Wang Shuo finally regained some strength.

"Slow down, slow down, hey, I can't even swallow it!"

After a while, Wang Shuo said feebly.

He sat up and barely regained some mobility.

He looked up and checked the attributes of the golden boss.

[Toad (ID: Frog 00001 Brunei, golden boss)]

[Level: Level 30]

[Attack power: 998]

[Defense: 400]

[Health value: 30000]

[Skills: Deterrence (passive), giant tongue attack, overwhelming. 】

See such appalling properties.

Damn it!

Damn it!

I'm so excited!

Wang Shuo was extremely shocked!
